protocol.selection: Frozen before scores: per language, two repositories sorted by SHA256(sgrep-eval-v1:repo); five needles each by SHA256(sgrep-eval-v1:repo:original_index). 60 queries/12 repos/6 languages. No post-score selection or tuning.
protocol.primary: target file Recall@1/5/10 and MRR@10; at least 50% target-function source lines within 8000 o200k tokens; secondary2000 tokens. Deduplicate lines preserving output rank.

methods.ripgrep: literal OR of identical sgrep query terms, case insensitive, --json --sort path, no semantic ranking; return matching lines only
methods.jevgrep: dzhng/jevgrep703aba1 native TypeSafe provider jev-1.13.0, no answer cache, concurrency32, default token/request budgeting unchanged, native excerpts rendered in tool order

protocol.timing: Quality runs may overlap CK index setup; their elapsed time is diagnostic only. Reported latency comes from a separate sequential replay on the first selected question per repository (12 queries, two per language), after indexing and quality runs finish, across all four methods. Fresh process for native CLIs, resident native Jev adapter, cached model downloads, no answer cache. All failures included.
protocol.limits: This is a stratified 10% sample of the six-language local release (600 queries), not full-repo real-world issue resolution. Source snapshots ~1MB average, public model training overlap unaudited. Python seen before; other language queries not used for tuning.
failure_contract: full100rankingregression completed before freezing new multilingual scoring
